data.name: 6-Passenger Capacity Premium 5 Hour Whale Watch | Targeting 10+ Species of Cetaceans
data.headline: Runs Fall-Spring: If You Don't See Whales Your Next Trip is Free! Minimum Age 16
data.description:
October through the end of the year is a wonderful time to venture offshore San Diego, as this is when we have our best weather and calmest sea conditions. The extended time on the water virtually guarantees whale sightings. Humpback Whales will be the main species of baleen whale targeted, with Fin Whales, Minke Whales, Bryde's Whales, and more all possible. We will also have increased odds at spotting rare species like Orcas this time of year as well. When conditions and time allows, we may also stop at our "Great White Shark Park" to search for Great White Sharks as well! 

**The Vessel**

These trips will all be on 6 passenger maximum capacity vessels! There will be a restroom on board for your convenience

If you do not encounter whales on your trip, you will receive a voucher for the amount of your ticket price to use towards a future trip with Gone Whale Watching

meeting_point.address: 1617 Quivira Rd San Diego, CA US 92109

data.what_is_included: - The excursion includes an offshore San Diego boat trip from October through year’s end during optimal weather and sea conditions for guaranteed whale sightings—primarily humpbacks along with fin, minke, Bryde’s, and occasional orcas—and, when weather and time allow, a stop at the “Great White Shark Park” to search for great white sharks.
data.cancellation_notes: We have a strict no cancellation policy. The captain may at his discretion, cancel any trip for unfavorable sea conditions for which a full refund will be issued.
data.booking_notes:
## More Information

MINIMUM AGE IS 16 FOR EXTENDED TRIPS!
 
Please arrive a minimum of 30 minutes before the tour start time as parking can occasionally be difficult around Mission Bay. Our pick up location is the dock in front of Sportsmen's Seafood. 1617 Quivira Rd, San Diego, CA 92109.
Please do not park in the lot designated for restaurant patrons only! Feel free to call us at 858 500 2568 with any questions.
___________
### What to Bring 

- Jacket (it can get quite chilly on the water, even on bright sunny days)
- Sunscreen
- Sun Glasses
- A light lunch or snacks
- Water
- Cash if you wish to tip the crew
___________
data.restrictions: Please note our vessel is extremely fast and can encounter the occasional bump on the open ocean. For this reason, we do not recommend these trips for anybody with back or neck problems. We also do not allow passengers that are pregnant, or passengers that are unable to board and exit the vessel without assistance (call for further clarification).
